thread:
olivia: Quick handoff before I step out — planned prod deploy at 23:00 UTC tonight. Small infra/config change to autoscaler thresholds + a restart of the runtime controller. Expected risk: low, but watchers needed during rollout window. Freeze window: 22:45–23:15 UTC.

liam: Thanks — can you paste the rollout plan and rollback command?

olivia: Rollout plan: canary 10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (10m). Watcher checklist: error rate, 95th latency, token cost spike, and pods in CrashLoop. Rollback trigger: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m or >=3 CrashLoop events in controller pods. Rollback command (one-liner):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod
```

liam: Good. Who's watching the canary steps? I can take the 10% -> 50% if ryan takes 50% -> 100%.

ryan: I can watch 50%->100%. I'll be online for the window. If anything weird shows up I'll escalate to @sre-jamie.

olivia: Awesome — watchers: liam (10%->50%), ryan (50%->100%), backup: sre-jamie. Please ping me and deploy-bot if you need to pause.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued by olivia — target: prod, start_time: 2026-11-07T23:00:00Z (23:00 UTC). Canary strategy: 10/50/100. Rollout owner: olivia.

sre-jamie: FYI — small note: controller restart can cause short-lived leader-election spikes; keep an eye on controller-manager logs and the event queue. If you see >1m of leader election churn, pause and call an SRE.

marie: Quick health-check commands to run during the canary:
`kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=redwood-runtime -o wide`
`kubectl top pods -n prod | grep runtime`
`curl -sS https://prod-health.redwood.internal/health | jq .`

liam: I'll run those and share a short status at each step. Also will monitor the latency dashboard (per-route) and token cost delta.

olivia: Thanks — two more micro-notes: 1) No schema or DB changes in this deploy, so safe for quick rollback. 2) If anything blocks, prefer pause + diagnose rather than full rollback unless rollback criteria hit.

ryan: Noted. I'm taking the oncall shift handoff at 00:00 UTC — olivia, you good to sign off?

olivia: Yup, I'm off. Logged these notes in the runbook under "prod_autoscaler_tweak_2026-11-07". Thanks team :rocket:

sre-jamie: I'll keep Slack open for the window. If you need DMs escalate with @here.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary 10% -> monitoring. Logs: `deploy-7890` streaming to #deploy-logs.

liam: Canary 10% complete — no errors, 95th latency stable. Moving to 50% now.

ryan: 50% rollout looks healthy so far. No CrashLoop and CPU steady. Moving to 100%.

liam: 100% rolled out, post-checks green. Closing the window — nice and smooth.

olivia: Amazing. Thanks everyone for watching. I'll follow up in the runbook later with the perf numbers.
